description: Conversion of 1x 4-bed single-family dwellinghouse into 2x 3-bed self-contained flats.
decision_conditions: The proposal, due to the substandard internal floor area of both flats, and the insufficient access to private amenity space associated with the first-floor flat, results in the provision of a substandard level of living accommodation. This is due to the over-intensive use of the site, which gives rise to poor living conditions to future occupiers of the property, creating cramped and awkward living conditions. The proposal would therefore be contrary to Policy 3.5 and accompanying Table 3.3 of the London Plan (2016), Policy CP4 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010), policies DMD5, DMD8, DMD9 and DMD 37 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014), the London Housing SPG, the objectives of the NPPF and the Nationally Described Space Standards.

The proposal fails to provide convenient access to the proposed cycle storage associated with the first-floor flat and fails to provide sufficient storage space to the required number of cycle spaces necessary to service both dwellings, resulting in inadequate active transport options for occupants, without adequate information to demonstrate otherwise. This is contrary to Policies CP24 and CP25 of the Enfield Core Strategy 2010, Policies DMD8 and DMD45 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014), Policies 6.9, 6.13 of the London Plan (2016) and as well as the National Planning Policy Framework.

The proposal, by failing to include the rear outbuilding as part of the application site to be subdivided, and in the absence of detailed information in respect to the access, layout and use of this building or part of the site currently gaining access via the proposed private amenity space associated with the first-floor flat, would prejudice the living conditions of future residents of the development contrary to Policy 3.5 and accompanying Table 3.3 of the London Plan (2016), Policy CP4 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010), policies DMD5, DMD6, DMD8, DMD9 and DMD 37 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014
